name: UnicornAI
author: Kirin
short: Autonomous AI persona using OpenAI-compatible endpoints (NanoGPT by default).
description: An AI cog that talks to OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoints (NanoGPT by default, or OpenRouter and others) to provide autonomous messaging and persona-based interactions.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the unicorn_ai cog!
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each user's AI opt-out preference. Channel history is sent transiently to the configured AI provider for response generation. Red data-deletion requests clear the preference.
